# Third-party UI sources

- `app/assets/tailwind/daisyui.mjs`: DaisyUI 5.5.23 standalone Tailwind plugin,
  copied from the reference application's vendored bundle. Its MIT license and
  copyright notice are embedded in the file. Use the upstream release bundle
  when upgrading and review the version alongside Tailwind.
- `app/helpers/heroicons_helper.rb`: generic SVG paths adapted from the reference
  application's helper. Heroicons is copyright Tailwind Labs, Inc.; the upstream
  MIT notice is retained in `heroicons-LICENSE.txt`.

Upstream projects: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui and
https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons.
